unlisted_practices: Provide clinically meaningful explanations of AI outputs (link to clinical outcomes) rather than full algorithmic transparency
Use explainable AI techniques such as feature importance and relevance measures to support clinician interpretation of closed-loop neurotechnology outputs
Inform clinicians about training input data for AI-driven closed-loop neurotechnology

screen.reason: This is an empirical qualitative study (interviews with 20 clinicians) evaluating clinician perspectives, attitudes, and requirements regarding explainability in AI-driven closed-loop neurotechnology.
